name: bristle-20-grand-tour
description: THE SHOWCASE (suite-absent, keep-open): every Bristle capability chained on one canvas. One slider nudge cascades: edit_v1 (E1/E3) -> the EDITED image becomes the viewport backdrop AND the input to analyze_v1 with seeds+regions (SEED-2/E2), a draft paint whose strokes come back as identity-carrying curves (E5), and a 2500-dot stipple via the Extra passthrough (E6) - all on Auto. Then RunCompose performs stroke surgery and the engine re-renders the operated program. BR_Watch (E4) picks up the newest app-committed edit. Requires the engine on :8377.

checkpoints.name: grand-tour-ready
checkpoints.description: The edited backdrop with region borders, seed groups, and stroke curves all registered on the one frame (save-only; the studio is interactive from here)

asserts.description: E1/E3: the darkroom recipe survived the engine door
SEED-2/E2: the edited image analyzed; borders + seeds landed
SD3: BR_SeedView staged the bound-group overlay
E5 out-door: the paint plan came back as identity-carrying curves
E5 return-door: the surgered tree survived every gate
THE RULING, clean: nothing dropped on a valid round trip
E6: artgen_v0 rode the Extra passthrough through the door
E6+E3: the stipple plan rendered frame-true on the GH canvas
E4: the newest app-committed edit picked up (loop closed)
E4 loop guard: GH never picks up its own jobs
D1: the edited image letterboxed at canvas mm under everything

requires.fix: install the Slop yak package; on a dev machine a Release net48 build ships it to the Drive folder GH loads from - check `canary doctor` output for the location actually in use
install the Bristle yak package, or on a dev machine build %CANARY_REPO_BRISTLE% Bristle.GH (net48) and register its output folder in Grasshopper Developer Settings
this test loads a Slop definition from the CANARY_REPO_BRISTLE repo; check that repo out and point %CANARY_REPO_BRISTLE% at it (see workloads/tokens.json)
